component.name: SceneDeck
component.summary: Role-aware OBS scene and audio controller

description.p: SceneDeck is a native Linux controller for structured OBS Studio setups. It replaces the flat OBS scene list with a role-aware surface: primary scenes for live switching, module scenes for composition, and an integrated audio mixer for daily operation.

ul.li: Live page with primary-scene switching and audio mixer
Scene role system: Primary, Secondary, Module, Raw, Debug, Archive
Local scene registry with tags and protection flags

description.p: Keyboard scene switching, live audio metering, per-scene and per-source icons, and a mixer rebuilt to match OBS.

ul.li: Digit keys switch the Live scene cards in card order. The first card is 1, the ninth is 9, and the tenth is 0; each card shows its digit on a badge.
Slot numbers follow the scene order saved in Inventory, so reordering scenes there reorders the shortcuts.
Settings chooses how the digit is pressed: on its own, with Ctrl, Alt, Shift, Super, Ctrl+Alt or Ctrl+Shift, or after a vim-style leader key.
The leader key can be Space, Comma, Semicolon, Backslash or Backtick, and stays armed for a configurable timeout.
Ctrl and the digit is the default, because it cannot fire by accident while typing. Bindings that need no modifier stand down while a text field has focus.
Live per-channel volume meters, using the same zones, peak fall-off and twenty-second peak hold as OBS Studio.
Each bar shows the peak level, the loudest recent peak, loudness, and the level arriving from the device before the fader.
Audio cards are laid out as OBS mixer strips: a coloured scope header, the source name and level, a fader beside the meter, and mute and lock controls.
Pin an icon to any scene from Inventory, and to any audio source from its card, chosen from a curated Nerd Fonts set.
A new OBS theme reads OBS Studio's default look through libadwaita.
The sidebar now carries the application logo and name, and icons run through the status bar, settings rows and section headings.
Mixer audio cards no longer slip underneath the status bar when the window is short.

description.p: Remove privileged Snap interfaces that require manual store review.
Add Snapcraft packaging and Snap Store publishing workflow.
